speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Brain: Lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML); T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement. Serum B12 and Copper levels: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). Given the MRI findings of non-enhancing multifocal demyelinating lesions in the setting of ataxia, this is consistent with JC virus reactivation, likely due to an underlying immunocompromised state. Please confirm if you have a known history of HIV, chemotherapy, or immunosuppressive medication use.
